execute.description: Backfill stable Better Auth account issuers
execute.sql:
UPDATE public.account
SET issuer = CASE
  WHEN "providerId" = 'credential' THEN 'local:credential'
  ELSE 'local:oauth:' || "providerId"
END
WHERE issuer IS NULL
